principle: Every active public surface must know what it is trying to become, what it must not become, where a reader should go next, and how much first-party substance it should carry. Mission contracts guide architecture; they do not replace canonical knowledge owners.

density_intents.compact: short orientation/lookup surface; prefer routing over encyclopedic expansion
density_intents.focused: single-essay specialist; deepen argument rather than widen scope
density_intents.balanced: substantive specialist reader with a clear beginning, middle and exits
density_intents.deep-but-tiered: large gateway allowed only when short-path orientation precedes deeper sections
density_intents.compact-runtime: runtime-heavy explorer; static shell must still explain purpose and fallback routes
density_intents.deep-runtime: large runtime projection; failures must be isolated and static orientation must survive
density_intents.balanced-runtime: runtime-enhanced reader with meaningful static explanation and source/fallback routes

home.title: Home
home.become: A calm five-minute orientation to the project, Tim, Potato of Life and the five canonical gateways.
home.must_not_become: A compressed duplicate of House, Tim, Potatoism, World and Shadow.
home.reader_job: Orient a new reader quickly, state what the project is, and open the five canonical gateways without becoming a directory.

potato-of-life.title: Potato of Life
potato-of-life.become: The clearest semantic-center explanation from literal potato through project metaphor, relation and repair.
potato-of-life.must_not_become: A universal master page for biology, theology, philosophy, House and Axis.
potato-of-life.reader_job: Explain Potato of Life as the semantic center and route deeper canon, body, tradition, and research views.

tim.title: Tim Dooley
tim.become: The definitive portrait of Tim: development, work, public presence, mission, contradictions and routes outward.
tim.must_not_become: The complete Story, Claims corpus, theology or conflict ledger.
tim.reader_job: Present the main Tim Dooley portrait, development, public record, and evidence-linked project identity.

religion.title: Religion
religion.become: The introduction to project theology and its historical/comparative religious context.
religion.must_not_become: A substitute for the Bible explorer or a proof page for project claims.
religion.reader_job: Explain the project's religious framework and comparisons, then route detailed tradition study to specialist readers.

philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.become: The usable ethical and conceptual layer: perception, judgment, agency, repair, growth and relation.
philosophy.reader_job: Present core philosophical questions, arguments, parables, and relation-first concepts with provenance.

science.title: Science
science.become: A skeptical boundary layer separating analogy, hypothesis, formal model and established science.
science.must_not_become: A place where symbolic resemblance is presented as empirical validation.
science.reader_job: Orient the scientific and formal-model library, distinguish model from analogy, and expose testable work.

world.title: World
world.become: The empirical outward face for geography, institutions and real systems.
world.must_not_become: A projection of Potatoverse certainty onto external facts.
world.reader_job: Orient real-world geography, institutions, politics, and systems and route into current and specialist World views.

news.title: Current World
news.become: A lightweight current-events reader with exits into durable World context.
news.must_not_become: A permanent knowledge owner or a project-spin news feed.
news.reader_job: Show current external reporting first, with lightweight filters and exits into durable project context.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.become: The authoritative time lens for life/project chronology and wider historical overlays.
timeline.must_not_become: A second narrative Story or a second owner of canonical event content.
timeline.reader_job: Let readers inspect chronology and event development without becoming a second content owner.

foundation-timeline.title: Foundation Timeline
foundation-timeline.become: A specialist chronology for how traditions and institutions become established through stages.
foundation-timeline.reader_job: Inspect foundation histories and temporal layers across traditions and institutions.

explore.title: Explore
explore.become: Deep archive traversal after the reader already has a question.
explore.must_not_become: The primary way newcomers are expected to navigate the project.
explore.reader_job: Traverse relationships and backend-held knowledge when the reader wants deep archive exploration.

sources.title: Sources
sources.become: The trust contract explaining provenance, evidence status, corrections and verification routes.
sources.must_not_become: A claim that first-person testimony automatically outranks independent evidence in every domain.
sources.reader_job: Explain source authority, evidence status, and provenance and provide verification routes.

questions.title: Questions
questions.become: The human-language concierge that turns real questions into direct routes, answers, recovery tasks or research seeds.
questions.must_not_become: A static directory grouped only by internal archive domains.
questions.reader_job: Enter the project through concrete reader questions and route answers to their canonical owners.

index-a-z.title: A–Z
index-a-z.must_not_become: A definition engine or substitute for canonical owners.
index-a-z.reader_job: Resolve known terms quickly by name and send readers to canonical destinations.

context.title: Context & Evidence
context.become: A practical guide to how context changes interpretation and evidentiary weight.
context.reader_job: Explain context and source-reading conventions beneath the Sources surface.

story.title: Story
story.become: The lived narrative: scenes, people, places, making, loss, conflict, repair and change.
story.must_not_become: A flat claims list or a duplicate interactive Timeline.
story.reader_job: Tell the Tim Dooley story as a coherent narrative projection over canonical records.

collection.title: Collection
collection.become: A curated constellation of recurring clues, works and records.
collection.must_not_become: A second Works catalog or another canonical owner.
collection.reader_job: Present the Corporium collection as a curated body of works and records tied back to canonical owners.

works.title: Works
works.become: A chronological and functional gallery of what Tim/project made and what each medium revealed.
works.must_not_become: A doctrine page where creative output automatically becomes canonical truth.
works.reader_job: Present creative and project outputs by form while preserving doctrine and evidence boundaries.

interpretive-justice.title: Interpretive Justice
interpretive-justice.become: A focused ethics of fair interpretation, dossiers, provenance and reply.
interpretive-justice.reader_job: Explain interpretive justice as a focused philosophy essay and route to related concepts.

world-map.title: World Map
world-map.become: An interactive geographic/system explorer grounded in World-owned data.
world-map.must_not_become: A separate truth source or decorative map detached from provenance.
world-map.reader_job: Provide interactive geographic and system exploration without replacing World-owned knowledge.

politics.title: Politics & Geopolitics
politics.become: A neutral specialist reader for political ideas, institutions and geopolitics.
politics.must_not_become: A partisan recommendation engine or ranking page.
politics.reader_job: Present political and geopolitical material neutrally as a specialist World view.

axis.title: Living Axis
axis.become: A focused explanation of the project's movement/operator grammar across Source, Door, Plane, Tree and repair.
axis.must_not_become: The universal master page for theology, science and House.
axis.reader_job: Explain the Axis as a project operator and spatial relation within House architecture.

north.title: North
north.become: The bridge from symbolic North to observed geography/institutions to explicit programme proposals and constraints.
north.must_not_become: A conflation of sacred direction, political bloc, empirical geography and policy status.
north.reader_job: Explain symbolic North, geography, and programme distinctions without conflating them.

world-systems.title: World Systems
world-systems.become: A relation-first synthesis of institutions, dependencies, infrastructure and capacity.
world-systems.must_not_become: A replacement for domain-specific evidence owners.
world-systems.reader_job: Explain institutions, systems, and interdependence as a specialist World synthesis.

bible.title: Bible Comparison
bible.become: A source-aware Bible comparison explorer that exposes text, context, relation and mismatch.
bible.must_not_become: A one-to-one casting engine for modern people as biblical figures.
bible.reader_job: Provide a focused Bible comparison explorer with source-aware relation browsing.

trinity.title: Potato of Life Trinity
trinity.become: A focused explanation of project Trinity mappings and their differences from historical doctrine.
trinity.must_not_become: A claim that project geometry establishes Christian doctrine.
trinity.reader_job: Explain Trinity-related project mappings while keeping project interpretation distinct from tradition.

culture.title: Culture & Subculture
culture.become: A serious social-systems reader for culture/subculture formation, capture, repair and regeneration.
culture.must_not_become: The emotional center of the entire project or a default enemy taxonomy.
culture.reader_job: Explain cultures, subcultures, platforms, and information ecology as concrete World phenomena.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.become: A map of the ten knowledge-owning Dwellings and where subjects live.
rooms.must_not_become: The global menu every reader must learn.
rooms.reader_job: Explain the ten knowledge-owning Dwellings and help readers enter the right Room without becoming the global menu.

history.title: History & Time
history.become: The canonical method page for occurrence time, source time, interpretation time and reception time.
history.reader_job: Present historical context and lenses under Timeline while preserving canonical event ownership.

law.title: Law & Justice
law.become: A specialist reader for authority, procedure, rights, institutions and remedies.
law.must_not_become: Legal advice or a place where allegations become legal findings.
law.reader_job: Present legal and institutional material as a specialist World view with source boundaries.

economy.title: Economy & Finance
economy.become: A specialist reader for money, debt, banking, trade, ownership and obligations.
economy.must_not_become: A bridge that converts the fictional Mud Bank into real finance.
economy.reader_job: Explain economic, monetary, banking, and obligation systems and expose relevant institutional relationships.

house.title: Potato House
house.become: The project map for readers who want to know where knowledge lives and how owners connect.
house.must_not_become: Required reading for understanding Tim or a duplicate of all subject matter.
house.reader_job: Explain how the project fits together, its ownership architecture, and major spatial relationships.

spirit.title: Spirit
spirit.become: A focused explanation of Spirit as continuity/relation within project canon with historical/body comparisons bounded.
spirit.reader_job: Explain the Spirit relation within Potato of Life canon and route to supporting theology and body material.

life-body.title: Life & Body
life-body.become: A biology/body reader distinguishing literal organism facts, body analogies and project symbolism.
life-body.reader_job: Explain biological, body, and neuro material and its project mappings with empirical-symbolic boundaries.

research-lab.title: Research Lab
research-lab.become: The visible frontier for hypotheses, tests, failed ideas, promotion criteria and unresolved questions.
research-lab.must_not_become: A parallel canon where research candidates are treated as established.
research-lab.reader_job: Expose active research programmes, methods, tests, and unresolved questions without competing with domain owners.

paths.title: Paths
paths.become: Curated end-to-end journeys that answer real reader intentions across multiple owners.
paths.reader_job: Offer intentional cross-domain reading journeys generated from canonical ownership and relations.

elevator.title: Door / Axis Elevator
elevator.become: A spatial transition viewer showing how House layers relate.
elevator.must_not_become: A literal cosmology or substitute for House/Axis owners.
elevator.reader_job: Provide a spatial transition view across House layers while preserving Room and plane ownership.

inhabitants.title: House Inhabitants & Cases
inhabitants.become: Name-first lookup for people, cases and objects with clear type/context before deeper dossiers.
inhabitants.must_not_become: A hierarchy-only browser or a list that collapses people, symbols and cases into one class.
inhabitants.reader_job: Find named House inhabitants, cases, and objects without requiring knowledge of Room hierarchy.
